acceptance.heading: 1. Acceptance of these terms
acceptance.body: By accessing or using pherus.org, account.pherus.org, or any other Pherus product, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, do not use our services.

services.heading: 2. Our services
services.body: Pherus is a practical research, sciences, innovation, and technology company. Our products (including Pass, Health, Collective, Software, Transspace, and others listed on our showcase page) are at various stages of development — some active, some in development, some still in planning — and are provided as described on each product's own page.

accounts.heading: 3. Accounts and security
accounts.body: Some Pherus products require a Pherus account, managed through account.pherus.org. You're responsible for keeping your credentials secure, including any two-factor authentication or passkeys you set up. You can review and manage your active sessions and devices at any time from your account's security settings.

acceptableUse.heading: 4. Acceptable use
acceptableUse.body: You agree not to use our services to violate any law, infringe anyone's rights, distribute malware, or interfere with the normal operation of our systems.

ip.body: Where Pherus publishes source code under an open-source license, that code is licensed as described on our Licenses page, not under these Terms. Pherus product names, logos, and branding remain the property of Pherus Inc.

thirdParty.heading: 6. Third-party links and services
thirdParty.body: Our sites may link to third-party services we don't control. We aren't responsible for the content, policies, or practices of any third party.

disclaimer.heading: 7. Disclaimer of warranties
disclaimer.body: Our services are provided "as is" and "as available," without warranties of any kind, express or implied, including merchantability, fitness for a particular purpose, and non-infringement.

liability.heading: 8. Limitation of liability
liability.body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, Pherus Inc. is not liable for any indirect, incidental, special, or consequential damages arising from your use of our services.

governingLaw.heading: 9. Governing law

changes.heading: 10. Changes to these terms

contact.heading: 11. Contact us

overview.heading: 1. Overview
overview.body: This policy explains what data Pherus Inc. collects across pherus.org and our other products, and how we use it. It doesn't cover third-party sites we link to.

thisSite.heading: 2. This site (pherus.org)
thisSite.body: pherus.org itself doesn't have a sign-up form, account system, or data layer — browsing it doesn't create an account or submit any personal data to us. It sets one cookie, to remember your language preference; see our Cookie policy for details.

accounts.heading: 3. Pherus accounts (account.pherus.org)
accounts.body: If you create a Pherus account, we collect what's needed to run it: your email address, authentication credentials (handled securely, never stored as plain text), and, if you enable them, two-factor authentication or passkey data. We also keep a record of your active sessions and devices so you can review and revoke them yourself.

usage.heading: 4. How we use your information
usage.body: We use account data to operate, secure, and improve our services — for example, to authenticate you, prevent abuse, and let you manage your own sessions. We do not sell your personal data, and we don't run advertising or analytics trackers on our sites.

cookies.heading: 5. Cookies and local storage
cookies.body: See our Cookie policy for the full list of what we store in your browser and why.

storage.heading: 6. Where your data is stored
storage.body: Our infrastructure runs on Cloudflare (Workers, D1, KV, and R2). Data may be processed or stored on Cloudflare's global network as part of operating our services.

retention.heading: 7. Data retention
retention.body: We keep account data for as long as your account is active, and for [retention period] after deletion for security and legal purposes, unless a longer period is required by law.

rights.heading: 8. Your rights
rights.body: Depending on where you live, you may have the right to access, correct, export, or delete your personal data. You can manage most of this yourself from your account's security settings, or contact us using the details below.

children.heading: 9. Children's privacy
children.body: Our services aren't directed at children under 13 (or the minimum age in your jurisdiction), and we don't knowingly collect their data.

changes.heading: 10. Changes to this policy
changes.body: We may update this policy from time to time. We'll update the date below when we do.

contact.heading: 11. Contact us
contact.body: Questions about this policy, or requests about your data, can be sent to pherus@pherus.org.

intro.heading: What we use on pherus.org
intro.body: pherus.org sets exactly one cookie and one local storage entry, listed below. We don't use advertising cookies, analytics trackers, or any third-party tracking scripts on this site.

localeCookie.name: PARAGLIDE_LOCALE
localeCookie.purpose: Remembers your selected language (English, 中文, or Français) between visits.

themeStorage.name: theme (local storage, not a cookie)
themeStorage.purpose: Remembers whether you're using light or dark mode.

sessions.heading: Signed-in sessions
sessions.body: If you sign in to a Pherus account at account.pherus.org, that subdomain sets its own session cookie to keep you signed in. You can review and revoke your active sessions at any time from your account's security settings.

managing.heading: Managing cookies
managing.body: Most browsers let you block or delete cookies in their settings. Blocking the locale cookie just means we can't remember your language choice between visits — nothing else on this site depends on it.

changes.heading: Changes to this policy
changes.body: If what we store ever changes, we'll update this page and the date above.

about.description: We are a collective of like-minded individuals driven by curiosity and a desire to understand, improve, and innovate.

whatWeDo.heading: What we do
whatWeDo.body: Pherus is a practical research, sciences, innovation, and technology company — a place for curious ideas to become real things. We work across identity and access, health, justice, community, science, and software, moving from open questions to working systems.

whereBased.heading: Where we're based
whereBased.body: Pherus Inc. is based in Wakiso, Uganda.

howWeWork.heading: How we work
howWeWork.body: We open source what we can, and lean toward decentralised, practical systems over grand promises. We'd rather ship something small and real than talk about something big and hypothetical.

contact.lead: Questions, ideas, or just want to say hello? Reach us at

hero.heading: A detailed overview into the work we have accomplished or are currently working on.
hero.description: The work we do at Pherus touches many different fields, from identity and access management to health and legal technology.

pass.description: A personal identity system built on the idea of owning your identity. It's a decentralised system that allows you to control your own identity. It is built using modern web technologies and follows open standards.

health.description: A personal health system built on the idea of owning your health. It's a decentralised system that allows you to control your own health. It is built using modern web technologies and follows open standards.

collective.description: A system built on the idea of shared ownership. It's a decentralised system that allows you to build and create systems together.

research.description: Research and exploration into various fields. This is where we document our findings and share them with the world.
